scope: 120 ready-stage entities through the shared World and direct software renderer fixture
assumptions: Each renderer fixture uses 120 ready-stage procedural box entities with matching completed recipe identities for the selector expectation.
The mobile capture is a Chromium 390x844 viewport; it does not represent a physical phone.
limitations: The WebGL context runs under Chromium SwiftShader, so it does not measure native GPU performance.
The software canvas keeps resident/proxy IDs private; its live proxy count is inferred from the renderer's proxy marker arcs, while exact selection reasons come from the shared selectors.
